positions.name: ON Semiconductor (onsemi)
positions.catalyst: Amended Synaptics merger (Thu AH): onsemi now pays $123/sh all-cash (~$5.7B vs ~$7B prior cash+stock), removing share issuance and certain closing conditions; deal now immediately accretive to non-GAAP EPS, financed with cash + $2.45B Morgan Stanley term loan. +7.8% pre-market to $86.30. Exit by Tue 10/6 close; -5% stop / +8% target.
positions.risks: Competing bidder for SYNA could force a higher price; 36% below the June 52-week high; added leverage; NFP-day volatility.

positions.name: Tesla
positions.catalyst: Q3 production/delivery report due today (10/2). Company-compiled consensus 461,974 (range ~422K-482K; JPM 482K, Barclays 475K). Stock -8% over the prior five sessions into the print. +0.7% pre-market to $356.67. EXIT: flat by today's close regardless of print.
positions.risks: Binary print - Cantor sees 422K; 329x PE; 22% down YTD reflects demand worries.

positions.name: Moderna
positions.catalyst: Joins the Nasdaq-100 before the Oct 9 open (replacing Warner Bros. Discovery) - forced index-fund buying into the Oct 8 close. +0.8% pre-market to $190.45. EXIT TRIGGER: close at the Thu 10/8 close (index rebalance), or -7% stop.
positions.risks: Citi downgraded to Sell ($80 PT) on 9/30 after a 222% run; stock +500%+ YTD and just off its 9/29 52-week high; index demand may be front-run.

positions.name: Mattel
positions.catalyst: WSJ (10/1): Authentic Brands Group privately discussed a takeover valuing Mattel at >$20/share (~$6B); a person familiar confirmed preliminary talks to CNBC. Thu close $15.04 leaves ~33% gap to the reported price. $15.11 pre-market. EXIT TRIGGER: close on a formal bid or a Mattel rejection, or by Thu 10/8 close; -8% stop.
positions.risks: Talks 'very preliminary', no formal sale process; Thursday spike (range 12.40-16.70) can retrace; new CEO transition just announced.

positions.name: Broadcom
positions.catalyst: Bloomberg: banks arranging ~$60B of new AI-chip financing for Anthropic and others (incl. a $42B senior tranche) - funds future Broadcom custom-silicon demand; plus Micron's beat-and-raise read-through. +1.1% pre-market to $347.31.
positions.risks: 30% below June high; NFP/yield shock risk over the weekend; financing report not company-confirmed.

positions.name: Rocket Lab
positions.catalyst: Citi initiated coverage with a $105 PT (~49% upside), citing launch cadence and backlog after Rocket Lab's largest-ever Electron contract; ARK bought $16.5M of shares. +1.3% pre-market to $71.39.
positions.risks: 53% below the May high; high-beta space name (sector 'losing altitude' this week); negative earnings.

positions.name: Airbnb
positions.catalyst: KeyBanc upgraded ABNB to Overweight from Sector Weight with a $191 PT (core business growing steadily; hotel bookings a new growth leg). +1.6% pre-market to $163.06. Exit by Tue 10/6 close; -5% stop / +8% target.
positions.risks: Four-week losing streak into the call; travel demand sensitive to oil (~$90 WTI) and rates.

positions.name: KLA Corp
positions.catalyst: Day 2 of Micron FQ4 beat-and-raise read-through (higher FY27 capex, memory tight through FY28) - WFE names extending; AI chips broadly +1-2% pre with the 10Y back to ~5.24% from a 24-year high. +2.1% pre-market to $204.49.
positions.risks: 33% below June high; Seagate -10%/WDC -8% pre-market shows memory/storage still fragile; NFP at 8:30 ET.

positions.name: Amazon.com
positions.catalyst: Set-up into Prime Big Deal Days (Oct 6-7, 48 hours, 35+ categories) plus report it is moving ~$8B of Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips into an SPV and leasing them back (capex-light AI build). +0.5% pre-market to $249.40. EXIT TRIGGER: close at the Wed 10/7 close (end of event); -5% stop.
positions.risks: Event is well known/priced; 13% below the Aug high; SPV structure may raise accounting questions.

positions.name: Freeport-McMoRan
positions.catalyst: Copper holding near record (~$6.56/lb) on strike threats at major Chilean mines plus AI-infrastructure demand; mining sector rallying (Rio Tinto higher). $69.51 pre-market. Exit at Mon open.

positions.driver: Chile mine strike threats / copper near record
